context.problem_statement: Apply STL (Seasonal-Trend decomposition using LOESS) to decompose a weekly e-commerce sales time series into trend, seasonal, and residual components. Use a seasonal period of 52 weeks. Report: (1) trend direction and slope (linear regression on trend component), (2) seasonal peak week (week with highest seasonal component) and trough week, (3) seasonal amplitude (max - min of seasonal component), (4) residual variance as percentage of total variance, (5) strength of seasonality = 1 - var(residual) / var(seasonal + residual).
context.expert_knowledge: Use statsmodels.tsa.seasonal.STL with period=52. STL is robust to outliers unlike classical decomposition. Trend strength = 1 - var(residual)/var(trend+residual). Seasonality strength > 0.64 is considered strong. The ratio of residual variance to total variance measures unexplained variation. High residual variance suggests external shocks or structural breaks.
